parsed.notes:
Minimum qualifications are required; Preferred qualifications are optional. The general encouragement to apply does not change these labels.
Rust, C++, and Go are each labeled as explicitly named examples, despite the alternative-language requirement.
Container orchestration is an optional second mention of containerization; the required containers mention determines the collapsed label.
Security fundamentals and infrastructure security map to cybersecurity; the required fundamentals mention wins.
Running ML training or inference infrastructure is read literally as AI infrastructure, not model development or model serving.
Debugging alone is not treated as software testing and is left unmapped.
No explicit seniority or usable experience-duration signal is present; the reference to unspecified internal job-level requirements does not establish a level.
